title: Save is blocked for a negative $ Off, naming the tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, tier A on $ Off 5.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type -1 in tier A's first range.
  5. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The cell shows -1, or the field refuses the minus sign.

Step 5:

  • The save is refused and the cell is highlighted; the message reads tier A's name followed by ": enter $0.00 or more in every range." (or the minus sign was refused and the value is 1).
